title: Observed bedside responsiveness from causal pre-assessment EEG

evidence.supports: Preserved original source registration, source citations and proposed complete scientific endpoint; later implementation corrections are distinguished below.
Released 1..5 category admission, exact normalized RPS, full-person support and complete slot retention.
Prospectively policy-bound ordinal reporting and paired person intervals.
Recommended median decision, category-distance and conditional uncertainty caveats.

evidence.locator: Author project data/methods, previously inspected in source provenance
evidence.supports: Two 125 HzEEG channels and clinically repeated responsiveness observations; report versus chapter bibliographic status remains separate.
Original assessment/recording source; authentic person mapping and complete source census remain gates.
Inspected source-scope documentation distinguishing delivered software from authentic task execution.
Inspected source-scope documentation distinguishing delivered software from authentic task execution.

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: No model or human trial for this task is established by this source revision. Generated software checks are not participant performance.
excluded_claims: Public binarySoC score is this ordinal endpoint
Conditional fixed-prediction interval is unconditional clinical validation

disposition_reason: Exact ordinal primary/paired artifact scoring and secondary ordinal metrics exist. Source person/assessment joins, causal EEG packets, trained physiological comparators and participant execution remain unqualified.

scientific_target.question: How accurately can immediately preceding EEG estimate the recorded bedside responsiveness category at each authentic assessment?
scientific_target.known_answer: Released ordered MOAAS categories 1,2,3,4,5, with source-reported merging of original 0/1 and 5/6; missing/ambiguous ratings stay null.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Original clinician assessments in the DOSE-I release; evaluator consumes already authenticated released labels and does not invent a raw-scale recoding or replace them with binary SoC.
scientific_target.case_unit: Every original assessment slot, using complete 30 seconds of EEG ending before assessment begins; evaluable status is precommitted.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Biological person across repeated recordings/procedures;171 recordings are not 171 proven people.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Observed responsiveness under clinically/event-driven ascertainment; not continuous unbiased monitoring or direct measurement of consciousness.
exclusions: No consciousness, sedation dosing or clinical safety claim.
1,129 SoC transitions are separately counted, not extra ordinal targets.
Index-step MAE does not assume equal clinical severity spacing.

inputs: Complete two-channel 125 Hz EEG for the 30 second causal pre-assessment interval:7,500 values at full sampling, units and artifact/missingness masks.
A 40-pEEG table is an optional distinct representation only after its complete filter/lookback causality is verified.
forbidden_inputs: MOAAS/SoC labels, drug dose, clinical event codes, procedure progress, identifying metadata and future EEG/centered pEEG features.
observation_contract.case_identity: Scorer binds every assessment_id to recording_id, authentic person_id, outer fold and precommitted eligibility; no authentic full mapping or signal packet is published.
observation_contract.split: Outer folds group authentic people across repeated procedures; overlapping windows and every person’s recordings remain together. All choices and clinical-QC decisions use training evidence only.
observation_contract.coverage: Logical policy requires 171 recordings,7,328 assessment slots and 1,129 separate SoC transitions; these source-reported counts are not an independently authenticated native census. Every slot remains in coverage, including missing/history/artifact cases.

primary.name: Normalized ranked probability score, participant macro
primary.aggregation: For five-category probabilities sum four squared cumulative errors and divide by 4; average evaluable assessments within each biological person then equally across people. If any person has no evaluable assessment the full-person primary is undefined.
primary.rationale: Uses order and probabilistic uncertainty while preventing dense clinical assessment schedules from dominating.

secondary: Participant-macro ordinal MAE using prospectively fixed lower probability median; category recall uses the same decision.
Fixed-bin classwise reliability/ECE with equal-person weighting, support counts and no claim that ECE certifies calibration.
Paired original-arm RPS/MAE differences and separately support-matched transformed-packet diagnostics.

comparators.name: Participant-weighted ordinal prior
comparators.procedure: Freeze each fold prior before held assessments; preserve five categories.

comparators.name: Causal spectral/entropy ordinal model
comparators.inputs: Exactly the same 30 second EEG and training labels
comparators.procedure: Proposed train-only causal feature/normalization recipe and nested person-group tuning.

comparators.name: Train-only random forest
comparators.inputs: Same audited causal packet/features and label budget
comparators.procedure: Proposed competent nonlinear comparator; published binarySoC performance is not the ordinal baseline.

nuisance_controls: Dose/procedure-time-only auxiliary comparator measures schedule shortcuts without entering neural-only input.
Audit every feature/filter for future samples and embedded clinical/label columns.
Retain event-driven assessment density and artifact strata; transformed control maps require target-free physical provenance, same masks and within-person support.
evaluation.uncertainty: Secondary implementation offers fixed-prediction biological-person paired bootstrap. It is conditional descriptive uncertainty with shared cross-fit training dependence, not validated new-patient/refitting confidence. Native person identity is a prerequisite.
evaluation.failure_policy: All 7,328 slots required; evaluable cases need exact normalized five-category decimal probabilities, nonevaluable cases explicit null. Any missing failed evaluable prediction refuses aggregate; no target access before complete arm admission.

implementation.scorer_target: dosei_score.normalized_rps implements exact rational five-category RPS and full-person support; dosei_metrics adds separately frozen median/mode decision, MAE/recall/calibration and paired conditional intervals. No EEG is loaded or features fitted by these scorers.
implementation.delivered_scope: Complete declared-scope artifact primary and secondary numerical evaluation. Clinical targets/census, physiological references, input packets and candidate transport remain external.
missing: Authentic person/recording/assessment mapping, rating timing and source rights/code provenance.
Causal 30 second EEG and pEEG feature audit with clinical QC.
Train-only reference qualification and enforced matched-access candidate lifecycle.
implementation.execution_evidence: Generated full-count metadata and numerical tests establish software behavior only. No authentic clinical model performance or direct/viewer trial is established.

direct_observation.representation: Complete 7,500 value causal two-channel EEG or an explicitly matched waveform rendering.
direct_observation.boundary: No execution; exact full observation and mask/capacity policy required.
missing: Complete authentic packet and no-tools transport.

typed_viewer.representation: Potential calibrated two-channel 30 second waveform display with typed time/scale actions.
typed_viewer.boundary: No clinical timestamps/labels or dose overlays; cannot silently crop to salient segments.

tool_assisted.representation: Same pre-assessment waveform plus causal spectral/entropy tools.
tool_assisted.boundary: No centered/future-aware features; train-only fitted tools and fixed case budget.
missing: Audited physiological tools and protected input path.

frozen_program.representation: Precommitted ordinal predictor with fixed train-only fitting recipe.
frozen_program.boundary: Group all recordings per person; scorer schema does not enforce fit custody.
missing: Frozen execution lifecycle and authentic baseline.

summary: Replace unresolved category language with implemented authenticated released 1..5 ordinal target and exact normalized RPS.
Bind existing secondary ordinal metrics while retaining their prospective policy and conditional uncertainty limits.
Separate artifact evaluators from unavailable causal EEG/clinical-identity and candidate-access paths.
revision.source_review: Reviewed preserved scientific registration and named implementation code/documentation; reused cited primary source evidence already verified in these records. No scientific arrays or evaluator labels were opened in this revision.
